title: Nutritious Portuguese Chicken Skillet
description: A delicious and healthy Portuguese dish featuring chicken, hazelnuts, and a blend of spices, perfect for a low-fat meal prep option. This skillet dish is packed with nutrients and flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the chopped hazelnuts, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and let cook, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Let cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for meal prep.
